🍿Director: Lee Don-gu / Cast: Im Hwa-young, Park Jong-hwan, Nam Yeon-woo, Park Se-jun, Lee Seung-won

👉Synopsis

In Itaewon on Halloween, filled with excitement, a murder occurs at a bar that has already closed for the night. A mysterious woman happens to be there by chance, and as someone keeps visiting the place, the case takes an unexpected turn. When a bad guy meets an even worse guy, who will be the one to punish them?

👉Director's Intent

The mysterious woman, Jay, is not a character, but a phenomenon. A small society formed within a single space. I wanted to express the diverse human characters and current phenomena unfolding within that space through the lens of genre. --------------------------------------

When We Bloom Again

Director: Shin Kyung-soo / Cast: Park Won-sang, Woo Mi-hwa, Choi Deok-moon, Jo Hee-bong, Lee Ji-won, Park Seo-yeon

Synopsis

"Let's bloom again, beyond the stopped years."

Byung-ho, who lost Kyung-eun in a horrific accident 10 years ago and is gradually losing his memory.

His wife, Su-hyun, trapped in helplessness, ignores him while enduring her own pain.

One day, the pent-up fear of their eldest daughter, Chae-eun, who had been silently enduring, bursts forth.

"I'm afraid I'll lose Dad too..."

Remembering Kyung-eun in their own ways and burying their pain, they seek to reclaim the years that have stopped.

Director's Intent

Yeonbunhongchima and the 4.16 Sewol Ferry Disaster Family Association, who planned the 'Sewol Ferry Disaster 10th Anniversary Film Project [Spring is Coming],' selected the feature-length dramatic film 'The Day Cotton Blooms' as the final work to conclude the project, following the omnibus documentary 'Three Greetings' and the feature documentary 'The Years of the Wind.' The cotton mentioned in the film's title refers to the downy fibers that emerge when the pod bursts open, leaving behind the fallen cotton flower. Although it is a fruit, it is so fine and beautiful that it is called the 'second flower.' The film embodies the precious wish that our children, who tragically perished, will be reborn and live new lives.

#Ghost #GhostStory #SelfComfort #IndependentFilm

Independent Short Film 'Ghost Friend'

Director: Jung Hye-yeon / Cast: Shin So-yeon, Jo Hee-bong, Baek Ji-hye

Synopsis

A story about So-yeon, who visits the home of her deceased friend Ji-hye,

and struggles to hide a sex toy she found in Ji-hye's room.

Director's Intent

[Ghost Friend] originated from a contemplation on what I, as a living person, could do for a deceased friend. Through the protagonist, who struggles to secretly remove her dead friend's sex toy, I aim to cheerfully convey the message that friendship continues even after death!

Independent Short Film 'Suddenly'

Director: Kim Hae-jin / Cast: Seo Yi-su, Jo Eun-ji, Lim Ho-jun

Synopsis

Cho-hee is a girl whose armpits grow grass instead of hair. Due to her mother's absence, she visits her aunt, the only remaining family member with the same surname, only to encounter yet another form of growth.

Director's Intent

The continuous physical changes from birth to death felt like a fantasy. Through this film, I wanted to depict a girl undergoing secondary sexual characteristics witnessing a different kind of growth and accepting the unfamiliarity and fear associated with it.

en-US.title: Wow... I just started crying... The way Mom overcame loneliness when she was alive... was it a me...
en-US.description:
#IndependentFilm #MovieReview #ZoomInCenter @indieground_kr

This movie is available for free viewing from March 16th to 30th at the Indie Ground website's online screening room.

https://indieground.kr/indie/selectOnlineList.do

'ID_ Yeonggil's mom'

Director: Lee Yoon-seok / Cast: Shin Mun-seong, Jang Yu-sang

Synopsis

Yeong-gil is a family man in his 40s. His mother, Deok-ja, has passed away.

Overwhelmed by life and unable to do anything for his mother, Yeonggil submits the death certificate and heads to sort through Deok-ja's house with his son, Jun-su.

There, he discovers the metaverse game Deok-ja used to play and realizes that she had created a map of the places she wanted to visit while she was alive.

Yeong-gil and Jun-su begin the game to find out where Deok-ja truly wanted to go.

Director's Intent

In the digital age, people play games.

In this way, they find vicarious satisfaction by fulfilling desires they could not achieve in reality through metaverse games.

In doing so, our true selves are sometimes discovered within the game.

People leave behind an ID, not a name, upon death.

By truly facing the image of those who have departed in this way, one can come to realize their true selves.

And then, one can let them go.

Seon-ji prepares a pancake for the ancestral rites table with her friend Jin-hee, who has become her new sister-in-law.
She was definitely a cool friend before her marriage, but today, Jin-hee's attitude toward her mother, Yeong-sun, is unsettling.
